tei:div.tei:p: dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bsang mchod bya tshul mdor bsdus zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang bsangs rdzas rnams phun sum tshogs par byas la/ rang nyid lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas kyang rung zhing*/ gsang bdag gi nga rgyal la gnas na/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar sngon dang sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing*/ g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bsangs rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bsangs chen dri bsung zhim po sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra/ ā wārtā ya ā wārtā ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa/ baṃ swā hā lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ nas/ rū pa āḥhūṃ nas/ spar+sha āḥhūṃ/ rgyas par ni sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs bya'o/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig /bar dang*/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ kyai rang bzhin chos sku'i gzhal yas nas/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum la sogs pa/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba yi/

/yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /sman bla mi 'khrugs tshe dpag med/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /'jam dbyangs kun bzang spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor byams mgon la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /'od srung rab 'byor shā ri'i bu/ /kun dga' nye bar 'khor la sogs/ /nyan rang 'phags pa thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa/ /gnas gsum dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /phyag drug phyag bzhi zhal bzhi pa/ /gur mgon chos rgyal lha mo sogs/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /tshangs pa brgya byin dbang phyug dang*/ khyab 'jug tshogs kyi bdag po sogs/ /lha klu sde brgyad thams cad kyang*/ de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po sogs/ /sa bdag gzhi bdag thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /sdom khrom brag dkar la sngon sogs/ /mdo smad gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*/ khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /༈ kyai 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /mchod yul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*/ /bdug spos mar me dri chab dang*/ /zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis mchod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang*/ /dri zhim bsangs kyi dud pas mchod/ /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyang*/ /dri zhim bsangs= /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /dri= /byang chub sems dpa'= /dri= /nyan rang 'phags pa= /dri= /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro= /dri= /chos skyong srung ma= /dri=

/lha klu sdai brgyad= /dri= /sa bdag gzhi bdag= /dri= /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag= / bsangs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'dis/ /rtsa brgyad bla ma thams cad bsangs/ /yi dam lha tshogs= /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas= /byang chub sems dpa'= /nyan rang 'phags pa= /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad= /chos skyong srung ma= /lha klu sde brgyad= /sa bdag gzhi bdag thams cad= /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad bsangs/ ༈ /kyai mgron du 'os pa khyed rnams kyi/ /bsangs mchod rgya chen 'di bzhes nas/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ gnod cing 'tshe ba thams cad zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu= /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= /byis pa'i gdon chen bco= /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu= /lha yi gnod pa zlog tu gsol/ glu yi gnod pa= /srin po'i= /'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /gza' yi= /rgyu skar gnod= /sri ngan= god kha'i= /chags che'i gnod pa zlog tu gsol/ /mdor na mi mthun mi shes pa'i/ /rkyen ngan bar chad kun zhi nas/ /'dod rgu'i re ba rdzogs byed pa'i/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /rab brtan tshe yi dngos grub= /rab mdzes gzugs kyi= /rab snyan sgra yi= /rab zhim dri yi= /rab mngar ro mchog= /rab 'jam reg bya'i= /myur mgyogs rta yi= /'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i= /bcud ldan zas kyis= /dgos 'dod rin chen= /gter chen bum bzang = /mkho rgu'i yo byad= /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /kyai mchod gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ / 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen kun/ /legs par sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su/ /mchod pa ngan zhing ma tshangs dang*/ /dgyes par bskyed pa'i nus med sogs/ /nongs par gyur pa'i nyes pa rnams/ khyod rnams spyan sngar mthol bshags kyis/ /bzod par bzhes te rang rang gi /gnas su slar yang gshegs par mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog

/yi dam lha yi= /sangs rgyas rnams kyi= /sems dpa'i tshogs kyi= /nyan rang 'phags pa'i= /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i= /chos skyong rnams kyi= /mi la tshe dpal bkra shis shog / phyugs la g.yang gi bkra shis shog /zas la bcud kyi bkra shis shog khyim la 'byor ba'i bkra shis shog /g.yang chags mi 'gyur bkra shis shog /bkra shis rgyun mi chad par shog /don rnams thams cad 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// bkra shis// //mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bsangs yig 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas bzhugs/ -PAGE 68--PAGE 67--PAGE 66-
